Marcella Metallic one-sleeve gown: live check refused, price from catalog
Marcella Velvet one-sleeve gown: live check refused, price from catalog

picks.name: Liore cutout dress, red
picks.say: Seventy-one dollars for a red dress with one shoulder and a cutout. It's ponte, so it's thick and it holds you in.
picks.why: Red, mid-stretch ponte, ankle length, back slit. $71 from $178.
picks.for_who: Office party or dinner where you want one clean red dress.
picks.skip_if: You want to wear a normal bra. The cutout won't allow it.

picks.name: Black bow mini
picks.say: Mac Duggal is prom-heavy, but this one is good. Ruched taffeta mini with a bow that drops to the floor.
picks.why: Fully lined taffeta, strapless, 35 inches long. $159 from $348.
picks.for_who: New Year's Eve. This is the going-out one.
picks.skip_if: You hate strapless, or you might return it. It's final sale.

picks.name: Leopard halter mini
picks.say: If everyone else is in sequins, wear leopard. Halter neck, open back, half price.
picks.why: Lined, tie-up halter, hem is longer at the back. $129 from $259.
picks.for_who: Birthday dinners and parties that aren't formal.
picks.skip_if: You run cold. The back is open. It's also 100% polyester.

picks.name: Silk charmeuse midi
picks.say: This is the grown-up pick. Washable silk, was four twenty-nine, now one thirty-five.
picks.why: Washable silk charmeuse, V-neck, tie at the back, removable shoulder pads. 69% off.
picks.for_who: Work party, then again in spring with a blazer.
picks.skip_if: You want something tight or short. This one hangs loose.

picks.name: Metallic one-sleeve gown
picks.say: A floor-length metallic gown for sixty-four dollars. One sleeve, open back. People will ask where it's from.
picks.why: Stretch lurex, halter neck into one long sleeve. $64 from $159. Also comes in black.
picks.for_who: Winter wedding guest who wants a long dress under $100.
picks.skip_if: The wedding is conservative. The pale one reads almost white.

picks.name: Teal halter midi
picks.say: The color is the reason. Teal, high neck with a rosette, open back, and it's a midi so you can dance.
picks.why: Charmeuse, pleated bodice, about 50 inches long. $198 from $398.
picks.for_who: Winter wedding. It photographs well and it isn't black.
picks.skip_if: You're a 4, or a 12 and up. Those are gone. It's 100% polyester.

picks.name: Fifi ombre sequin midi
picks.say: My splurge. Blue-to-gold sequins, was six ninety-five, now two seventy-eight. Nobody else at the party will have it.
picks.why: Sequins on a mesh base, strapless, side slit. 60% off.
picks.for_who: New Year's Eve, if you want to be the one in the photos.
picks.skip_if: You want to blend in. And check returns first, it's tagged final sale.

picks.name: Velvet one-sleeve gown
picks.chip: Black: XS to XXL in stock
picks.say: My favorite. Black velvet, one sleeve, a long slit, sixty-four dollars. This looks like it cost four hundred.
picks.why: Velvet jersey, column cut, one-shoulder neckline, long side slit. $64 from $159.
picks.for_who: Black tie on a budget. Also the easiest one to rewear.
picks.skip_if: You want the crimson. It's missing XS, S and XL.
